data.name: Irqbaanht
data.gender_notes: Irqbaanht is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is powerful and mighty, the one who has strength and courage, the one who inspires fear and respect. The name Irqbaanht carries the meaning “Powerful, mighty, strong” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Irqbaanht usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, mighty, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner strength and courage, inspires respect and fear, and represents the power of God.
data.etymology: Irqbaanht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, mighty, strong.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irqbaanht total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Irqbaanht" signifies power and strength in Islamic culture. It is a name that relates to courage and valor, and is often given to boys who are expected to grow up and become strong and fearless leaders. The name is derived from the Arabic word "irqab," meaning "horse," which symbolizes strength and power. In the Islamic world, horses have long held a place of great honor and respect, representing not only physical strength but also bravery and battle prowess. Therefore, the name "Irqbaanht" carries a powerful cultural message of strength, courage, and respectability.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Irqbaanht" signifies the belief in the power and strength of God. It is a reminder that true power and strength come from faith and reliance on God, rather than from worldly possessions or physical strength. The name encourages the bearer to strive for inner strength and courage, to face challenges with faith and determination, and to seek guidance and support from God in times of difficulty. Ultimately, the name "Irqbaanht" is a reflection of the Islamic belief in the power and mercy of God, and is a reminder to constantly seek His guidance and strength in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Powerful, mighty, strong" symbolizes The one who is powerful and mighty, the one who has strength and courage, the one who inspires fear and respect.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Irqbaanht serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of powerful, mighty, strong.
